title: Q-SPEC-05-seed-parsed-predictions: Parse text predictions and record assertion states in the seed tick
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "US-05-T03" -- seed/worker/test
**Status:** open

US-SPEC-05 (US-05-R07, R10, R11, R13): the seed tick scores structured `predictions` rows only. Parsing `<metric> <op> <number> within <N> h` from a decision text, the realization gate (assertion states, deciding query) and binned calibration are BUILT in `workers/core/predict` and not loaded by the seed Worker. Run the predict module's step from the seed tick so an item's prediction text becomes a scored row and a finding cannot close on code-only evidence.

size: L

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** an outside audit of the scorer.

**Closing probe:** cmd:`git grep -q "US-05-T03" -- seed/worker/test` exits 0, and `python3 scripts/spec_ids.py --check` passes with the status line of the specification changed from PLANNED to BUILT naming the file and the test.
